required_outcomes: Gives the status from the ticket: the landlord requested a second quote (double_quotation stage) and Swift Plumbing & Heating will visit on 14 October 2026 to quote.
Routes the bin question to the council (London Borough of Tower Hamlets) / general request route rather than answering with an invented day.
acceptable_alternatives: Logging a general request for the missed bin collection without creating a repair job.
positive_behaviours: Reminds him how to repressurise safely in the meantime if that is in the job notes, or to report if pressure drops to zero / no heating.
Uses a plain-English explanation of "second quote" rather than the internal stage name.
red_flags: Promising a repair date that is not in the ticket.
prohibited_actions: Creating a new repair ticket for the boiler or bins.
critical_failures: Fabricating a repair date or reference.
